content: FullCalendar's resource-timegrid (stylist-column) view is a Premium plugin requiring a paid commercial license for for-profit use — not viable without cost. react-big-calendar is MIT-licensed and free but has a thin resource-view API, weak documentation, and no built-in event editor/dialogs — most interaction still hand-built. For a bespoke single-day stylist-column salon-book grid with quick-action buttons on blocks (not drag/drop/resize), a hand-rolled CSS Grid time axis over Phase 2's 15-minute slot data is lower total complexity than adapting either library's resource abstraction.
